title: ServiceRequest
description: One report of a problem or request for service - a pothole, a broken streetlight, an abandoned vehicle.

@type.description: Always `ServiceRequest`. Mirrors Open311 GeoReport v2, which is the established standard and remains the source model; this is a schema.org projection of it, not a replacement - schema.org has no service request concept of any kind, so `gs:ServiceRequest` is minted outright. Deliberately has no fields for the reporter's name, email, phone, device ID, or account ID: those exist in the Open311 POST payload and must not survive into published data. See the privacy section in the profile README.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this request beyond its `@id`.

serviceRequestId.description: The publisher's own request number, as shown to the public. Open311 `service_request_id`.

serviceCode.description: The code of the service requested. Open311 `service_code`. Must match a `GovernmentService` in the catalogue.

description.description: The reporter's account of the problem. Free text submitted by a member of the public: treat as untrusted, and review before publishing, since people put their own names and phone numbers in here.

requestStatus.description: termCode from the `ServiceRequestStatus` code list. Open311 defines only `open` and `closed`; anything other than `closed` maps to `open` for Open311 compatibility.

statusNote.description: Public explanation of the current status. Open311 `status_notes`.

geo.description: schema.org `GeoCoordinates`. Round coordinates for requests at residential addresses - see the privacy section of the profile README.

address.description: schema.org `PostalAddress`, when the request concerns one rather than coordinates alone.

location.description: A named `Facility` or `Place`, where the request concerns one.

image.description: schema.org `ImageObject`. Open311 `media_url`. Photos submitted by the public routinely contain bystanders, licence plates, and house numbers; review before publishing.

additionalProperty.description: Answers to the service's own questions, as schema.org `PropertyValue` with `propertyID` matching the attribute's `valueName`. Open311 `attribute[]`.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.

duplicateOf.description: The request this duplicates, when `requestStatus` is `duplicate`. A reference, not prose: 'Duplicate of 2025-104882' in a status note cannot be followed by anything.

relatedAlert.description: An `Alert` this request concerns. A service disruption is both: the disruption is an alert, reports about it are requests.

statusHistory.description: Timestamped record of how the request progressed. Without it only current state is visible, so nobody can see how long a request sat unassigned - which is exactly what residents and service-level measurement need.
